info.title: AICTE Integrated Complaint Case Monitoring Dashboard
info.description: Centralized, role-based complaint monitoring and lifecycle tracking platform for AICTE bureaus/cells.

get.description: Healthcheck endpoint verifying application runtime and database connectivity.

post.description: Authenticate with email and password, returning signed JWT token.

get.description: Retrieve active authenticated user profile, jurisdiction, and permissions.
Convenience endpoint for judging evaluation: generate a token for the specified role.

post.summary: Dispatch 2FA OTP / Aadhaar VID verification challenge
post.description:
Sends a time-bound verification challenge to the provided phone or email target.
In development and sandbox modes, provides pre-filled OTP for immediate verification.

post.summary: Verify OTP challenge and generate Complainant Verification Token
post.description:
Validates the 6-digit OTP code against the challenge transaction.
Returns a signed verification token that permits grievance submission.

get.summary: Inspect status of a verification token
get.description: Validates whether an active verification token is valid and unexpired.
Retrieve paginated case catalog with server-side bureau scoping, institution search, and dynamic sorting.

schema.description: Search by subject, case reference ID, category, or institution name

schema.description: Field to sort by: created_at, due_date, priority, status, subject

get.description: Real-time SLA aging surveillance radar: categorizes active cases by breach risk.
Export filtered complaint records as an RFC 4180 CSV file with role-based redaction.

post.description: Pre-validate CSV grievance data with granular field errors, institution validation, and duplicate detection.
Atomically commit pre-validated CSV rows inside a transactional boundary.
Execute lifecycle state advancement with guard validation and audit recording.
Authorized reopening of a previously resolved grievance.

get.description: Retrieve chronological append-only audit stream for the case.
Retrieve case internal notes. Read-only auditors cannot view confidential notes.

post.description: Add an internal note to the case dossier. Emits an immutable NOTE_ADDED audit record.
Reassign case to another bureau or officer with mandatory procedural justification.

get.description: Retrieve full delegation and transfer history for the case.

post.description: Escalate a case to higher supervisory surveillance tier with mandatory justification.

get.description: Retrieve all evidentiary attachments for a complaint case.

post.description: Upload and verify an evidentiary proof document (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX).

get.description: Retrieve all active AICTE bureaus and cells for filtering and assignment.
Retrieve active officers and personnel assigned to a specific AICTE bureau.
Retrieve aggregate executive KPIs, bureau workload breakdown, and status distributions.
Retrieve lifecycle stage dwell-time latency metrics and operational bottleneck detection.
Retrieve non-toxic cross-bureau volume comparison and resolution velocity.

post.summary: Check potential duplicate complaints using TF-IDF cosine similarity
post.description:
Evaluates incoming grievance text against registered database complaints
using TF-IDF n-gram vectorization and cosine similarity.

get.summary: Check duplicate collisions for an existing case reference
get.description:
Computes duplicate collision matches for a specific complaint dossier,
excluding self-comparison.

post.summary: Compute explainable bureau routing and categorization recommendation
post.description:
Recommends optimal bureau, category, and priority based on domain keyword
affinity and institutional historical complaint patterns, outputting
transparent explainability rationale factors.

get.summary: Generate triage suggestion for an existing registered complaint dossier
get.description: Generates intelligent triage suggestion for an existing case in the register.

post.summary: Human-in-the-Loop decision gate: apply triage recommendation to case
post.description:
Strict Human-in-the-Loop Gate (AI-04):
Updates case bureau, category, and priority upon explicit officer confirmation,
recording an immutable CaseAuditEvent tracking the human approval.
